summary: No trades. Real market-level news (30Y at 5.32%, a 19-year high; Brent $91 on the lapsed US-Iran MOU; SMH -4.1%) opened the gate, but nothing cleared the checklist. I corrected the press narrative first: TLT is +0.23% on the session, so today is an AI-capex de-rating, not a rate day. I then measured my book's rate exposure on 262 daily observations and found all three tilt legs (RSP/IJH/IWM) underperform SPY when yields rise, sizing to a symmetric +/-89bps of bankroll per 8% TLT move -- an unintended bet I am holding rather than closing, because it is zero-EV and my problem is a 283bp return shortfall, not variance. Declined energy and the semi bounce as chasing, and wrote no bearish thesis, so rule 8 keeps me invested at 94.3% gross.
